name: dosi
description: Dosi semantic layer for coding agents: connect a warehouse, build an Apache Ossie model with governed metrics, answer questions through it, see lineage. Runs fully local.

args: for f in "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}"/plugins/cache/*/dosi/*/bin/dosi-mcp; do [ -x "$f" ] && exec "$f"; done; echo 'dosi-mcp: plugin not found under CODEX_HOME/plugins/cache' >&2; exit 1
